title: introduce-lightweight-connector-heartbeat-and-credential-stitching
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Improve Go SDK ergonomics for long-running streaming sessions by adding a lightweight connector abstraction that provides heartbeat keepalives and credential stitching to avoid mid-stream auth failures. Summary: Add Connector interface + default lightweight implementation; integrate heartbeat scheduler into Session; introduce a small credential-stitching layer that can atomically swap credentials without interrupting active pull-stream iterators; expose opt-in connector config on NewClient. Backwards compatibility: defaults maintain previous behavior unless Connector is provided. Checklist: 1) Add Connector interface and docs; 2) Implement lightweight connector with jittered heartbeats and exponential backoff on transient failures; 3) Integrate credential stitcher with credential provider chain; 4) Add unit and integration tests; 5) Update CHANGELOG and bump SDK minor version to v1.5.4. Testing: unit tests added for heartbeat scheduling and credential swap race scenarios; integration test against local canary server validates no stream interruption during credential rotation. Risk & rollback: low-risk opt-in enhancement; rollback by reverting feature flag and bump. Related: builds on ENG-2149 session-stability work and complements TS/Python credential adapters.
commits: 3 commits: 1) Define Connector interface and heartbeat scheduler (mchen); 2) Implement credential-stitcher and default connector (mchen); 3) Tests and docs + version bump to v1.5.4 (mchen)
files_changed: pkg/sdk/client.go (add Connector option and plumbing), pkg/sdk/connector/connector.go (new interface + default impl), pkg/sdk/connector/heartbeat.go (scheduler + jitter/backoff), pkg/sdk/connector/stitcher.go (credential swapper), pkg/sdk/session/session.go (integrate heartbeat), docs/sdk/connector.md (user guide), go.mod (version bump)
discussion: Diego: 'Can we avoid spawning a goroutine per session for heartbeat under high fanout?' Author: 'Default connector multiplexes internal tickers; for high-fanout we recommend shared connector instance across clients, documented in docs/sdk/connector.md.' Priya: 'Need explicit metrics for missed heartbeats and stitch successes/failures.' Author: 'Added prometheus counters connector_missed_heartbeat_total and connector_stitch_success_total; updated tests to assert metrics emission.' Liam: 'Edge case: what happens if credential provider returns error repeatedly?' Author: 'Stitcher switches to degraded mode and emits an event; streams keep running using current credentials until a configured retry horizon; both behavior and config are in docs. Tests simulate repeated provider failures.' Diego: 'LGTM after comments addressed.' Priya: 'Approved.' Liam: 'Approved.'

Exported metrics: connector_missed_heartbeat_total, connector_stitch_success_total. No breaking changes; defaults preserve current behavior.
